answer: The harbor of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The kernel is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the marble. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, converted to a slow vesting stream, rewards vest against future work.
